head: Google Voice update brings a new Android design like Google Messages
dek: The Google Voice app for Android is getting a new look borrowed from Google Messages: a rounded search bar, slightly bolder fonts and a rounded message box with the same plus and camera buttons. It's the app's first noticeable update since 2023.
details: 9to5Google saw the design in version 2026-11-01 of the app. The send button now shows an "SMS" label, as in Google Messages, where it tells you whether a text goes as SMS or RCS. Code found in an 11 November update also mentions RCS, but Google hasn't announced RCS for Voice or given a date. Material You colours apply unevenly: fully on a Pixel, only on the message box on a Galaxy Z Fold 8.
where: US only (Google Voice is a US service), Android, rolling out now
means: If you use a Google Voice number on Android, the app will look more like Messages; calls and texts work as before.
todo: Update Google Voice from the Play Store to get the new design; RCS chat isn't there yet.
thumb_words: GOOGLE VOICE GETS A NEW LOOK
